items.body:
Adds four networks and folds four operators into existing ones. Existing typical prices were not changed: I found no evidence that any has moved.

| Change | Old | New | Source and figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| New network `waEvNetwork` (matches "wa ev network", "wa ev highway", "horizon power") | n/a | typical 0.60, published | Horizon Power pricing page, as returned by search: DC "0.60c" (read as $0.60) and AC 0.35, unchanged for 2026/27. The page refused my fetch (403), so I could not read it directly. Its early FAQs also say $0.60 DC. https://www.horizonpower.com.au/utilities/pricing/ |
| New network `exploren` (matches "exploren", "engie"), siteReading `forbidden` | n/a | typical null | Search results from several sites agree Exploren took over Engie's DC network in 2025. Third-party trackers give $0.30–1.04 a kWh, so no typical price. |
| New network `electrona` | n/a | typical null | One PlugShare listing says Bicheno DC $0.65, which is one site only. |
| New network `wevolt` | n/a | typical null | Trackers give differing ranges (35–73c). |
| Chargefox `match` gains "yurika", "queensland electric super highway" | n/a | n/a | yurika.com.au and a QESH summary say charging is through the Chargefox app. |
| Chargefox `match` gains "raa" | n/a | n/a | RAA's own site (raa.com.au/motor/motoring-services/ev-charging-stations): charge and pay in the Chargefox app. |
| Chargefox `match` gains "electric highway tasmania" | n/a | n/a | Search results say EHT uses Chargefox for billing. |

Chargefox's own typical price (0.60) was left as it is.

**Not sure about**
- "raa" is a short substring and could match an unrelated site name. Worth a glance when the app's matching is checked.
- "Charging the Regions" (25 fast sites) looks like a council programme whose sites run through Chargefox or Evie, depending on the site. I left it undecided in memory.
- Woolworths is recorded as a site owner only.
- The Electric Highway Tasmania and Yurika/Chargefox links rest on search summaries rather than a page I could open, because the Yurika and RAA pages I tried by guessed URL returned 404.
- No network's `checked` date is more than six months old, so there is no issue to raise about stale prices.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]((claude.com/redacted)
items.title: [prices] Add Exploren, WA EV Network, Electrona, WeVolt; Yurika, RAA, EHT join Chargefox
